messages.content: The collection page still adds one tool at a time. Product wants a package-level add that respects duplicates and the collection cap, and the API should not fail the whole request when some tools are skipped.
How should bulk-adding all tools from an npm package to a collection work?

Validate the package, calculate remaining collection capacity, skip duplicates, bulk insert with duplicate protection, log activity without failing the request, and return added, skipped, limit, and tool details.
How should bulk-adding all tools from an npm package to a collection work?
Agents need memories that survive across sessions. The skills embedder is visible in the tree, but not the payload and model the memory service itself should use.
Which data shape and embedding model should the TPMJS memory service use?
TPMJS stores arbitrary JSON memories and uses OpenAI `text-embedding-3-large` for semantic search.
Which data shape and embedding model should the TPMJS memory service use?
A collection needs a custom MCP server that Codex can list tools from. Schema, auth, client generation, and the editor install still have to happen in the right order.
What steps should I follow to integrate a custom MCP server with an editor?
Register the server, configure bearer authentication, apply and generate the Prisma client, run the idempotent editor install, then restart the editor and verify tool discovery.
What steps should I follow to integrate a custom MCP server with an editor?
Production exceptions already reach Sentry with a DSN. Review still needs the webhook-to-issue-to-constrained-fix-to-PR path, including when Discord is allowed to fire.
How should production errors flow from Sentry through an automated fix PR?

Capture release and request context, authenticate and deduplicate the webhook, create or reuse the GitHub issue, run a constrained auto-fix, open a PR, and notify Discord only after that state transition.
How should production errors flow from Sentry through an automated fix PR?
The auto-fix path is wired, but review wants the failure cases covered before merge, not just a happy-path webhook test.
What should the test plan cover for the Sentry auto-fix pipeline?
Test webhook validation, deduplication, fix failures, PR creation, and notification behavior, then run the focused suite and full checks.
What should the test plan cover for the Sentry auto-fix pipeline?
Browser errors reach Sentry without route or release context, so the backend remediation path cannot tell duplicate page failures apart.
How should frontend Sentry tracking be instrumented and verified?
Configure safe route and release context, verify transport to the remediation path, deduplicate events, and test capture and transport failures.
How should frontend Sentry tracking be instrumented and verified?
Playground still logs Simulations, agents log Messages, and API keys log ApiUsageRecord. Tool, agent, and collection runs need one execution-event path that cannot block deleting those entities.
How should TPMJS unify execution tracking across tools, agents, and collections?
Use one fire-and-forget execution event model without foreign-key coupling, instrument each boundary with source and status, expose filtered pagination, and aggregate daily counts.
How should TPMJS unify execution tracking across tools, agents, and collections?
Local build and type-check runs in this Turborepo are slow. Improve the development feedback time while retaining the checks used for final verification.
How can I make the workspace build, lint, and type-check workflow faster without reducing coverage?

Local build and type-check runs in this Turborepo are slow. Improve the development feedback time while retaining the checks used for final verification. Inspect the task graph, use filtered or cached tasks for diagnosis, validate cache inputs and outputs, compare timings, and finish with complete verification; use a clean or cache-disabled run when validating a build-system change.
How can I make the workspace build, lint, and type-check workflow faster without reducing coverage?
Agents can discover registry tools, but a hang and a denied permission both look like silent failures in the conversation log.
What sequence should dynamic tool execution follow for approval, permissions, timeouts, and audit?

Discover and enrich the tool, wait for explicit approval, check every required permission, execute with a timeout, and record the outcome, returning actionable errors for denied or undiscovered tools.
What sequence should dynamic tool execution follow for approval, permissions, timeouts, and audit?
The agent conversation needs shell and file operations that keep working-directory state, without leaving leftover sessions on disk.
How should the sandbox shell and file tools be implemented?
Create or reuse a conversation session, validate inputs, return structured stdout/stderr or file metadata, preserve state across calls, and destroy the session during cleanup.
How should the sandbox shell and file tools be implemented?
CI still has only unit tests around the sandbox client. We need an isolated server run that does not touch production credentials.
What should the sandbox integration test workflow verify?
Start an isolated test service, exercise create, execute, read, write, list, and destroy, assert persistence and timeout behavior, and keep CI data away from production.
What should the sandbox integration test workflow verify?
A git-status tool should join the existing sandbox session rather than open a second workspace, and failures still need structured output.
How should additional sandbox shell tools preserve state and report results?
Reuse the conversation sandbox session, validate commands and paths, return stdout/stderr or file metadata, and test failure and cleanup paths.
How should additional sandbox shell tools preserve state and report results?
Codex lists zero tools against the collection MCP URL copied from the HTTP docs. I need the endpoint editors actually speak.
Which MCP transport endpoint should custom servers expose for editor integrations?
Editor integrations use the streamable HTTP `/mcp/stream` endpoint rather than the non-streaming `/mcp` endpoint.
Which MCP transport endpoint should custom servers expose for editor integrations?
A custom executor is being added beside the default runner. Review is worried execution could skip the same approval and permission gates the default path uses.
When an agent runs a discovered tool, which checks must stay in front of execution so a custom executor cannot skip approval?
Keep discovery, explicit approval, permission checks, timeout, and audit around every execution path, including custom executors, and return actionable errors when a tool is denied or undiscovered.
When an agent runs a discovered tool, which checks must stay in front of execution so a custom executor cannot skip approval?
On the agent detail page I only see that a sandbox tool ran, not the stdout the user needs to debug a failed command.
How should sandbox execution logs be exposed in the agent detail page?
Filter sandbox tool names, match inputs to results by tool-call ID, render complete output, show the tab only when enabled, and add pagination and optional refresh.
How should sandbox execution logs be exposed in the agent detail page?
The collection tools POST handler returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED for a collection that still has room. Trace `_count.tools` against `COLLECTION_LIMITS.MAX_TOOLS_PER_COLLECTION` and fix the comparison.
I added a column in `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` for local iteration. How should I apply that schema change in development versus production without leaving the generated client stale?
The homepage statistics look incorrect. Trace the data source and fix the displayed values.
The timeline deployment is running after every commit, but it should update only once a day. Fix the CI trigger.
Why can’t I see collections or tools to add as nodes in the builder? Diagnose and fix it.

@tpmjs/official-memory documents several tools. Add every tool from that package into this collection without dropping tools that are already there or overflowing the cap, and tell the caller what was skipped.
When I send `hi` to the OpenRouter agent, the conversation returns an export object and no generated response. Debug the stream and expose useful error information.
Post a Discord notification to `#tpmjs` whenever a new user signs up, including the user’s email.
Research the TPMJS codebase and prepare an investor-ready TAM analysis for the product.
Redesign the Omega landing and chat pages using the existing brutalist command-center visual language.
